description:
Erection of single storey hipped roof outbuilding in the
rear garden
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [Fire Safety Strategy, Unnumbered Location Plan, GTD1116 - 0HA3, GTD1116 - 01HA3, GTD1115 - 02HA3, GTD1115 - 03HA3, received 20/02/2023, GTD1115 - 04HA3A received 18/05/2023].

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), [no additional windows shall be inserted in any part of the development] [and] [no additional dormer windows] shall be constructed.
